"GitHub")](https://github.com/crystal-nest/pyrotechnic-elytra/issues) --- ## **描述** 无论你飞向何方，都能为所有人创造一场烟花秀！ 现在，任何颜色、效果或形状的烟花火箭都可以用来助推你的飞行！ ![白天飞行](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crystal-nest/mod-fancy-assets/main/pyrotechnic-elytra/day-flight.gif "Pyrotechnic Day Flight") ![夜晚飞行](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crystal-nest/mod-fancy-assets/main/pyrotechnic-elytra/night-flight.gif "Pyrotechnic Night Flight") ## **依赖项** | 模组 | 加载器 | 要求 |
